name: virgil-lsp-vscode
description: Development client for the Virgil language server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The language server analyzes the workspace's source files, so it starts only in trusted workspaces.

virgil.server.path.markdownDescription: The `virgil-lsp` executable: a command name looked up on `PATH`, or an absolute path. `virgil-lsp-worker` must be in the same directory as the executable it resolves to. With Remote-SSH or Remote-WSL, set this in the remote settings.

virgil.virgilRoot.markdownDescription: The absolute path of the Virgil checkout or installation (the directory that holds `lib/`) that project files' `virgilDependencies` are relative to. When empty, the `VIRGIL_LOC` environment variable of the extension host is used. With Remote-SSH or Remote-WSL, set this in the remote settings.

virgil.trace.server.markdownDescription: How much of each LSP message to record in the trace. The trace goes to the "Virgil Language Server" output channel while its log level is Trace: run **Developer: Set Log Level...** and choose Trace for that channel.
